species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 58°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–34 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 65 ft, so fish stay above it.
North wind at 12 mph pushes bait onto the south shore: try the wind-blown banks.
